completion.about: Vectors for the completion hold of docs/cross-app-semantics-v1.md section 7. Times are milliseconds from the start of the sequence. Events: complete, hoverStart, hoverEnd, focusIn, focusOut (a row id in "row", or "target": "toast"), navigate, and undo ("via": "row" with a row id, or "via": "toast"). Each expect entry is the state after every event up to and including that time, with timers due at that time already fired (a timer fires before an event at the same instant). held and collapsed are row ids in ascending order.

vectors.name: pointer on the row extends the hold
keyboard focus on the row extends the hold
pointer and focus both keep the row
engagement that starts during the hold restarts it
leaving the view ends every hold early
navigating with nothing held changes nothing
completions merge into one toast and restart its clock
undo from the toast reopens what the toast covers
undo from the toast leaves a row that is still held alone
undo of a held row cancels it without a toast
completing a held row again keeps the first deadline
completing again after an undo starts a new hold
pointer on the toast keeps it
keyboard focus on the toast keeps it
a completion that collapses while the toast is hovered joins it
a completion after the toast is gone starts a new toast
undo after the toast is gone changes nothing
a row held while another collapses stays held
a timer ends before an event at the same instant

dateDisplay.about: Vectors for the date display rules of docs/cross-app-semantics-v1.md section 8. now and due are local wall-clock times in zone; for the logbook contexts due is the completion time and dateOnly is false. Expected strings are built from names and patterns (never from platform locale data): they use plain ASCII spaces, Sep for September, am/pm in lower case in en-GB and AM/PM in en-US.
